approach: Static recompilation of PPU and SPU code with ps3recomp, Direct3D 12 RSX draw engine; installer recompiles on the user's PC
notes: v0.2.4 alpha (ps3recomp v0.18.0): playable in its first areas — character control at 60 fps with the original game speed (cinematics keep their original 30), DualSense / DualShock 4 and XInput controllers, Exit Game in the title and pause menus. No game files included: the installer checks the user's own copy, decrypts the executable with the user's RPCS3 and recompiles it locally; releases ship SHA256SUMS.txt and pinned Python dependencies. Developed with AI assistance (Claude), directed and tested by the maintainer. Known issues: some sound effects missing, long black screen before the first cinematic, no anti-aliasing, fixed 1280x720.
